name: How should homeowners prepare their home before bathroom demolition begins?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare their home before bathroom demolition begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your contractor begins, clear out all personal belongings from medicine cabinets, vanities, and linen closets, and set up a temporary hygiene station in another bathroom. You should also confirm your material selections, such as tile, grout color, fixtures, and vanity sizing, before demolition starts to prevent work stoppages. Establish a dedicated staging area in a garage or spare room for materials, and decide on a clear pathway through your home for crews hauling debris and construction tools. Protecting nearby floors with drop cloths or temporary coverings is also essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all cabinets, confirm fixture selections, designate another bathroom for daily use, and establish clear pathways and staging areas for crews.
